title: Board projection
description: Body of an `evidence` artifact: one project's board as the `TASKS.md` projection renders it (design/board.md), at the moment a board task's run was admitted, for a native agent that reads files rather than MCP. A projection of the store, never read back; bounded in tasks and characters (design/workflow-engine.md#tasksmd-in-a-runs-workspace).

format.description: tasks-md: the board's TASKS.md Markdown, per task its id, title, state, criteria, and why it waits.

tasks.description: The project's tasks when it was rendered, listed or not.

truncated.description: Whether the text was cut at its bound in characters (a note at its end says so).
